release: War Room OS V9.7 Limited-Production Trading Control Plane
human_summary: Lima market sudah memiliki route eksekusi, quote collector, deterministic sizing, pre-trade risk limits, human HMAC approval, manual broker-neutral order export, kill switch, fill reconciliation, dan immutable execution ledger. Tanpa exact-scope proof yang sah, output tetap NO TRADE.
claim_limit: 5/5 means the limited-production control plane is operational for all five markets. It does not mean five profitable strategies have been proven.
